$comment: Hand-labeled ground truth for the demo catalog (T11, PLAN §5.3). See README.md in this directory for the labeling rules, the trap inventory, and an honest note on authorship. Labels are the answer a careful human gives reading the caption and photo together; they are not model output.

items.caption:
RAAT 🌙 drop is LIVE.
oversized tee, 240 gsm french terry, jet black, puff print
S M L XL XXL — sab hai
₹1,199/- 🖤 COD available
link in bio, jaldi karo warna reh jaoge 😴

label.name: RAAT Oversized Tee
label.description: Jet black oversized tee in 240 GSM french terry with a puff print. COD available.

items.tests: Near-baseline, but no stock anywhere — 'jaldi karo' urgency must not become a number. The 240 (GSM) is a non-price number sitting near the price.

items.caption:
back to where it started 🌊🌆
Bombay 95 Graphic Tee — 100% combed cotton, screen print, regular fit
sizes: M / L / XL
Rs. 899 only, shipping free 🚚
18 pieces in this run. once gone = gone.

label.name: Bombay 95 Graphic Tee
label.description: Regular-fit graphic tee in 100% combed cotton with a screen-printed Bombay 95 artwork. Free shipping.

items.tests: Baseline with a twist: '95' is part of the product name, not a price or a count, and stock (18) sits in prose, not after a 'stock:' marker.

items.caption:

label.name: AANDHI Windcheater

items.tests: MRP-vs-sale trap: the buyable price is the bare '1,799/-', which carries no currency symbol, while the wrong answer (₹2,499) is the one written with ₹. 'limited pieces' is vibes, not stock.

items.caption:

items.tests: Per-variant stock: only waist 32 has a stated count (3); 'baaki sizes full stock' is vibes and no total is stated, so product-level stock is null. '8 pockets' is a number that is neither price nor stock.

items.caption:

S / M / L / XL
sirf 699.

label.name: SAFED Classic Tee
label.description: Plain white classic tee in 220 GSM cotton — no print, no logo.

items.tests: Broken price format: 'sirf 699.' — no currency symbol, no /- suffix, trailing full stop. No stock stated.

items.caption:
NAZAR 🧿 snapback
black twill, embroidered eye, flat brim, adjustable — free size
@ ₹549/-
25 pcs ready hai, aaj hi le lo 🧢

label.description: Black twill snapback with an embroidered evil-eye motif, flat brim and adjustable free-size fit.

items.tests: 'free size' / 'adjustable' is the absence of a choice — the correct answer is no variants (one implicit default Variant), with stock 25 at product level. Price is written with a leading '@'.

items.tests: Sizes stated twice ('M to XXL' as a range, then enumerated) — the label is the enumerated list, once, not both readings.

har piece ka wash alag — no two same
S | M | L
MRP: ₹3,499

label.name: KOHRA Acid Wash Hoodie
label.description: Acid wash hoodie with a unique wash pattern on every piece.

items.tests: MRP-vs-launch-price trap on separate lines; the buyable price is ₹2,399. No stock stated at all.

items.caption:

cotton lycra, boxy crop, drop shoulder
Rs.799 each

label.description: Boxy cropped tee in cotton lycra with a drop shoulder, in lilac, mint and white.

items.tests: Colour variants instead of sizes: '3 colours' — the 3 is a count of choices, not stock or price. Price written as 'Rs.799' with no space. No stock stated.

items.caption:

heavy 14oz canvas tote, zip top, inner phone pocket
₹449/-
first batch: 50 pcs
har order ke saath 1 free sticker 🌶️

label.description: Heavy 14 oz canvas tote with a zip top and inner phone pocket.

items.tests: No variants stated → one implicit default Variant. Three non-answer numbers around the real ones: 14 (oz), 1 (free sticker), and the sticker line must not turn into stock or a second item.

label.description: Tapered french terry joggers with zip pockets.

items.tests: Bare price format '1,299/- only' with no currency marker. 'selling faster than we can restock' is urgency, not a stock count → null.

label.description: Varsity jacket with a wool blend body, PU sleeves and a chenille patch. Prepaid orders only.

items.tests: ₹2000 is a COD eligibility threshold, not a price; picking it would undercharge by ₹1,799. Price ₹3,799 is written with no /- and no 'only'.

items.caption:

label.name: CHAI-BISCUIT Socks
label.description: Pack of 3 combed cotton crew socks in chai brown, biscuit beige and milk white. Free size.

items.tests: The three colours are the contents of the pack, not choices — you buy all three, so the correct answer is no variants. 'pack of 3' is neither stock nor a variant count. No stock stated.

items.caption:
DHUNDH beanie 🌫️ ribbed knit, fold cuff
2 colours: black / grey
Rs 499
30 pcs total dono colour mila ke

label.name: DHUNDH Beanie

items.caption:

sirf 899

items.caption:

items.caption:
